title: Heterozygous loss of Engrailed-1 and alpha-synucleinopathy (En1/SYN): A dual-hit preclinical mouse model of Parkinson's disease, analyzed with artificial intelligence.
authors: Stetzik, Lucas; Mercado, Gabriela; Steiner, Jennifer A; Lindquist, Allison; Gilliland, Carla; Schulz, Emily; Meyerdirk, Lindsay; Smith, Lindsey; Molina, Jeremy; Moore, Darren J
one_liner_zh: 该文构建帕金森病小鼠模型并用AI辅助组织学分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, we develop and validate a new Parkinson's disease (PD) mouse model that can be used to better understand how the disease progresses and to test the effects of new, potentially disease-modifying, PD therapies. Our central hypothesis is that mitochondrial dysfunction intercalates with misfolded alpha-synuclein (alpha-syn) accumulation in a vicious cycle, leading to the loss of nigral neurons. Our hypothesis builds on the concept that PD involves multiple molecular insults, including mitochondrial dysfunction and aberrant alpha-syn handling. We predicted that mitochondrial deficits, due to heterozygous loss of Engrailed-1 (En1+/-), combined with bilateral injections of pathogenic alpha-syn fibrils (PFFs), will act to generate a highly relevant PD model - the En1/SYN model. Here, En1+/- mice received bilateral intrastriatal stereotaxic injections of either PBS or alpha-syn fibrils and were analyzed using automated behavioral tests and deep learning-assisted histological analysis at 2, 4, and 6 months post-injection. We observed significant and progressive Lewy body-like inclusion pathology in the amygdala, motor cortex, and cingulate cortex, as well as the loss of tyrosine hydroxylase-positive (TH+) cells in the substantia nigra. The En1/SYN model also exhibited significant motor impairments at 6 months post-injection, which were however not exacerbated as we had expected. Still, this model has a comprehensive number of PD-like phenotypes and is therefore superior when compared to the alpha-syn PFF or En1+/- models alone.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们开发并验证了一种新的帕金森病（PD）小鼠模型，该模型可用于更深入地理解疾病进展过程，并测试新的、可能具有疾病修饰作用的PD疗法的效果。我们的核心假设是，线粒体功能障碍与错误折叠的α-突触核蛋白（alpha-syn）积累相互交织形成恶性循环，导致黑质神经元丢失。该假设基于PD涉及多种分子损伤的概念，包括线粒体功能障碍和异常的alpha-syn处理。我们预测，由于Engrailed-1杂合缺失（En1+/-）导致的线粒体缺陷，结合双侧注射致病性alpha-syn原纤维（PFFs），将产生一个高度相关的PD模型——En1/SYN模型。在此，En1+/-小鼠接受双侧纹状体立体定位注射PBS或alpha-syn原纤维，并在注射后2、4和6个月通过自动化行为测试和深度学习辅助的组织学分析进行评估。我们观察到杏仁核、运动皮层和扣带皮层中显著且进行性的路易体样包涵体病理，以及黑质中酪氨酸羟化酶阳性（TH+）细胞的丢失。En1/SYN模型在注射后6个月也表现出显著的运动障碍，但并未如我们预期的那样加剧。尽管如此，该模型具有全面的PD样表型，因此优于单独的alpha-syn PFF或En1+/-模型。
